ModMetaData.name: Many Happy Returns - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Many Happy Returns, run by Pickle. Development only: never published, never part of the distributed Mod/ folder.
Written, not yet run. The suite deliberately holds only what a running game can show: the morning letter and its translated text, the hidden settings shortcut and its real Dialog_ModSettings, an actual Scribe write/read of the settings file through the game's own PreClose, the wish exchanged between two real colonists through Pawn_InteractionsTracker.TryInteractWith and its own duplicate-protecting selection weight, and the graded end-of-day memory formed through MemoryThoughtHandler.TryGainMemory, including its nullifying-trait and short-tenure exemptions. The pure scoring arithmetic underneath - which grade a score maps to, how wishers are weighted, the settings' clamping - is proven out of game by Tests/ManyHappyReturns.Tests.csproj and is not replayed here.
The name Pickle's -pickle-run filter wants is the display name above, not the folder.
See TESTING.md for the scenarios this suite comes from, and Tests/Pickle/README.md for what is covered here, what stays manual, and how many passes a verdict needs.
